findings.text: _trip_state reads presence.get('axis_inside_limiter'), a key no producer sets: the committed run output trip-trajectory/trajectory.json records axis_inside_limiter: null for both the label axis and trip 1, so the one quantity this node's diagnosis turns on is never persisted.

base_arrays sets 'limiter': prepared['wall'], but _prepare_frame returns only 'wall' (measure_branches.py:241). The saved limiter array is therefore the wall (z range +/-1.664 m), not the DIII-D limiter (+/-1.359/+1.363 m), so every panel drawn from these npz files shows the wrong boundary and an axis at Z=+1.563 m reads as inside the limiter.

promotion_step_norm_wb is amplitudes[0] for every k, so each re-solve reports trip 1's step norm instead of trip k's; the persisted 1.090 Wb for frame 146 contradicts the node's headline discriminator (first_step_amplitude_wb 25.2774 Wb from trace_vertical_loss.py) by 23x for the same seed.

_trip_state re-implements the per-arm summary projection (presence/mask_history/amplitude_history) that build_receipt.py:29 _arm_summary owns and that trace_vertical_loss.py was repaired to import at revision 27064633c, re-forking the capability the prior review flagged.
The module docstring usage names --frame 146 while argparse accepts --frames, and label_axis_inside_limiter is initialised to None and never filled.
